title: Albatross integration — soleng scratchpad
content:
Daily scratchpad for Albatross Health private deployment (working notes, config scraps, action items). 

-- quick context --
Customer: Albatross Health (HIPAA-bound POC)
Mode: Private (VPC peering into prod-account), initial set: 2 dedicated GPU nodes, canary 1 node
Primary ask: low-latency chat+structured-output for triage assistant. Must support audit logs and KMS key control.

-- top-level deployment plan (sketch) --
1) VPC peering + route table updates (security review JIRA: SE-4789)
2) Provision Dedicated pool (2xA100-equivalent) behind regional gateway
3) Private control plane connector (customer-managed) + KMS integration
4) Canary rollout with traffic split 5% -> 100% over 48h if no regressions

-- immediate TODOs (today) --
- [ ] Confirm customer security contact + cert rotation window (Ping: @SecurityOps)
- [x] Share terraform skeleton for VPC peer (sent 2026-02-10, GH pr referenced above)
- [ ] Finalize CIDR exceptions for Albatross subnet (need 10.10.40.0/24 allow list)
- [ ] Add route53 private zone delegation notes into infra PR
- [ ] Set up read-only CloudTrail bucket access for customer auditors

-- config snippets / reminders --
Terraform var samples (copy into infra module):

variable "albatross_peer_cidr" {
  type = string
  default = "10.10.40.0/24"
}

// Security group: allow outbound 443 to redwood egress IPs and 9411 for tracing sink (if requested)
// NOTE: ask infra/sre for final IP list (ticket pinned in Slack thread)

Suggested serving config (notes, not yet prod):
- model: gpt-4o-redwood-ll (preferred low-latency)
- fallback_model: gpt-4o-redwood-q4 (quantized)
- max_tokens: 1024 (start conservative)
- batch_size: 16 (tune after perf run)
- kv_cache_ttl: 5m (prefix KV caching on for repeated prompts)
- stream: true (client wants streaming chat)

Routing policy note: route customer production to dedicated pool in us-east-1. If capacity low then fallback policy -> region: us-east-2 dedicated fallback. Automate via routing policy with tags: team:albatross, env:prod.

-- benchmark & perf checklist --
- quick perf matrix to run post-provision:
  * p95 token latency (expect < 85 ms for short prompts)
  * throughput: sustained 20 r/s at avg prompt length 150 tokens
  * memory pressure on GPU (watch kv growth)
- run load: bench/seq-latency-run.sh against canary with 5m ramp
- collect profiles to S3 path: s3://redwood-perf/albatross/canary-2026-03

-- open questions (to surface in SE sync) --
- Does Albatross require redaction at the ingestion layer? If so, need to push pre-tokenizer filter (SE-4794?)
- Backup plan if KMS onboarding delays > 2 weeks: allow use of Redwood-managed key and mark data tag "temp-kms" for audit
- What telemetry retention window do they want? default is 30d; customers in healthcare often ask 90d

-- customer-facing checklist for next call --
- confirm NOC window for cert rotation (they proposed 2am-4am ET)
- show canary run plan + rollback criteria (error rate > 1% or quality regressions in eval set)
- ask which eval prompts they care about (I pushed prompt set to Confluence page)

-- quick log (activity trace) --
2026-03-09: staged terraform module locally, hit missing route53 delegation permission (filed SE-4810)
2026-03-10: reached out to SecurityOps about cert rotation windows
2026-03-11: demo w/ product; client asked for streaming + function calling examples
2026-03-12: initial canary infra applied to test VPC (internal test only)

-- misc notes / heuristics --
- Keep TTL short on KV cache during canary to make behavior observable (1m) then bump to 5m after stable
- Start with small batch size to avoid latency spikes; measure tail latency before tuning throughput
- If customer requests PII scrubbing, recommend hosted preprocessing lambda or inline filter at ingress

Unresolved: need final sign-off from legal on BAA language (reminder: legal@redwood)

End of scratchpad for now — will prune and move actionable items into JIRA after next sync.
